# 870. Advantage Shuffle

## Solution 1 (time O(nlog(n)), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def advantageCount(self, nums1, nums2):
        """
        :type nums1: List[int]
        :type nums2: List[int]
        :rtype: List[int]
        """
        n = len(nums1)
        ans = [0 for _ in range(n)]
        nums1.sort()
        ids = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: nums2[i])
        left, right = 0, n - 1
        for x in nums1:
            if x > nums2[ids[left]]:
                ans[ids[left]] = x
                left += 1
            else:
                ans[ids[right]] = x
                right -= 1
        return ans
```
